# Get max benchmarking results
## real
```{r}
date <- "20250528_cpu"
evldir <- file.path("./results/benchmarking/results/real/", date, "eval")
```

```{r}
### Load the results of real data sets
files <- list.files(evldir, "*.rds", full.names = TRUE)

df_paras <- data.frame()
for (file in files) {
  data <- readRDS(file)
  df_paras <- bind_rows(df_paras, data)
}

df_paras$dataset <- gsub("_filtered", "", df_paras$dataset)
```

```{r}
df_real <- df_paras %>%
  filter(algorithm == "CAdir_auto") %>%
  group_by(algorithm, dataset) %>%
  mutate(max_NMI = max(NMI, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(max_ARI = max(ARI, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(ARI == max_ARI) %>%
  distinct(dataset, algorithm, max_ARI, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

df_real$max_NMI[is.infinite(df_real$max_NMI)] <- NA
df_real$max_ARI[is.infinite(df_real$max_ARI)] <- NA
```

## simulated
```{r}

date <- "20250528"
base_dir <- file.path("./results/benchmarking/results/simulated", date)
indir <- file.path(base_dir, "eval")
```

```{r}
zeisel_eval <- readRDS(
  file.path(

dfz <- zeisel_eval %>%

        "0.1_0.75_0.75",

```

```{r}
pbmc_eval <- readRDS(
  file.path(
    indir,
    paste0(date, "_pbmc3k_collated.rds")
  )
)

dfp <- pbmc_eval %>%
  mutate(dataset = "pbmc3k") %>%
  mutate(simulation = paste(dePROB, defacLOC, defacSCALE, sep = "_")) %>%
  mutate(
    simulation = factor(
      simulation,
      levels = c(
        "0.02_0.75_0.75",
        "0.06_0.75_0.75",
        "0.1_0.75_0.75",

```

```{r}
df_all <- rbind(dfz, dfp)
df_sim <- df_all %>%
  filter(algorithm == "CAdir_auto") %>%
  mutate(sim = paste0(dataset, "_", simulation)) %>%
  group_by(simulation, algorithm, dataset) %>%
  mutate(max_ARI = max(ARI, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(max_NMI = max(NMI, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(ARI == max_ARI) %>%
  distinct(
    dataset,
    simulation,
    algorithm,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_sim$max_ARI[is.infinite(df_sim$max_ARI)] <- 0
df_sim$max_NMI[is.infinite(df_sim$max_NMI)] <- 0
```

# Benchmark iterations real
```{r}
iters <- seq.int(1, 30, by = 1)
# iters <- seq.int(0, 10, by = 5)

res_list <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(data_files))
# options(rlib_message_verbosity = "quiet")
for (i in seq_len(length(data_files))) {
  iter_vec <- vector(mode = "numeric", length = length(iters))
  ari_vec <- vector(mode = "numeric", length = length(iters))

  f <- data_files[i]
  fnm <- gsub("_filtered.rds", "", basename(f))
  fnm <- gsub(".rds", "", fnm)
  cat("\n", fnm)
  sce <- readRDS(f)

  dft <- df_real %>% filter(dataset == fnm)

  if (dft$angle == 0) {
    cut_ang <- NULL
  } else {
    cut_ang <- dft$angle
  }

  set.seed(1234)
  sce_var <- scran::modelGeneVar(sce)
  sce_top <- scran::getTopHVGs(sce_var, n = dft$ntop, var.threshold = NULL)
  sce <- sce[sce_top, ]
  cnts <- as.matrix(logcounts(sce))

  ca <- cacomp(
    obj = cnts,
    princ_coords = 3,
    dims = dft$dims, #20
    top = nrow(cnts),
    residuals = "pearson",
    clip = TRUE
  )

  for (j in seq_along(iters)) {
    n <- iters[j]
    cat("\n\titer:", n)
    cadir <- dirclust_splitmerge(
      caobj = ca,
      k = dft$kdir,
      cutoff = cut_ang,
      apl_quant = dft$apl_quant,
      reps = n,
      convergence_thr = FALSE,
      keep_log = FALSE
    )

    ari <- aricode::clustComp(cadir@cell_clusters, sce$truth)$ARI
    rm(cadir)
    ari_vec[j] <- ari
    iter_vec[j] <- n
  }

  res_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    dataset = fnm,
    n_iters = iter_vec,
    ARI = ari_vec
  )
}
saveRDS(res_list, file = file.path(resdir, "real_res_list.rds"))
```

# Benchmark iterations sim

```{r}
iters <- seq.int(1, 30, by = 10)
# iters <- seq.int(0, 10, by = 5)
# iters[1] <- 1

res_list <- vector(
  mode = "list",
  length = length(sim_files)
)
options(rlib_message_verbosity = "quiet")
for (i in seq_len(length(sim_files))) {
  iter_vec <- vector(mode = "numeric", length = length(iters))
  ari_vec <- vector(mode = "numeric", length = length(iters))

  f <- sim_files[i]
  fnm <- gsub("_filtered.rds", "", basename(f))
  fnm <- gsub("dePROB-", "", fnm)
  fnm <- gsub("defacLOC-", "", fnm)
  fnm <- gsub("defacSCALE-", "", fnm)
  fnm <- gsub(".rds", "", fnm)
  ds <- stringr::str_split(f, "/")[[1]][5]
  fnm <- paste0(ds, "_", fnm)
  cat("\n", fnm)
  sce <- readRDS(f)

  dft <- df_sim %>%
    mutate(dataset_gsub = gsub("\\.", "_", sim)) %>%
    filter(dataset_gsub == fnm)

  if (dft$angle == 0) {
    cut_ang <- NULL
  } else {
    cut_ang <- dft$angle
  }

  set.seed(1234)
  sce_var <- scran::modelGeneVar(sce)
  sce_top <- scran::getTopHVGs(sce_var, n = dft$ntop, var.threshold = NULL)
  sce <- sce[sce_top, ]
  cnts <- as.matrix(logcounts(sce))

  ca <- cacomp(
    obj = cnts,
    princ_coords = 3,
    dims = dft$dims, #20
    top = nrow(cnts),
    residuals = "pearson",
    clip = TRUE
  )

  for (j in seq_along(iters)) {
    n <- iters[j]
    cat("\n\titer:", n)
    cadir <- dirclust_splitmerge(
      caobj = ca,
      k = dft$kdir,
      cutoff = cut_ang,
      apl_quant = dft$apl_quant,
      reps = n,
      convergence_thr = FALSE,
      keep_log = FALSE
    )

    ari <- aricode::clustComp(cadir@cell_clusters, sce$Group)$ARI
    rm(cadir)
    ari_vec[j] <- ari
    iter_vec[j] <- n
  }

  res_list[[i]] <- data.frame(
    dataset = fnm,
    n_iters = iter_vec,
    ARI = ari_vec
  )
}
saveRDS(res_list, file = file.path(resdir, "sim_res_list.rds"))
```
